subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the open fork PR for this issue, or should ClawSweeper queue a fresh upstream repair against the current `ui/src/pages/channels` paths?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and the fix shape is narrow, but the only open closing reference is not an upstream OpenClaw PR and older upstream attempts are closed unmerged.

options.title: Queue fresh upstream repair
options.body: Treat the fork PR as non-landable for upstream as-is and let a new focused fix target the current file layout with fresh proof.

options.title: Adopt or retarget the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer or contributor to bring the fork PR into `openclaw/openclaw` and refresh it against current main before review.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep the issue open without new automation until the fork PR author opens an upstream-ready PR.

recommendation.title: Queue fresh upstream repair
recommendation.body: Treat the fork PR as non-landable for upstream as-is and let a new focused fix target the current file layout with fresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The routing choice affects the channel UI/catalog path most directly tied to steipete's metadata centralization work.
